'''Alakatha''' was the primary [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[K'vath 5]] in the [[K'vath system]]. It was a popular resort world for [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] elite, with two semi-tropical continents. The moon was described as colored green and white from space, most likely due to plant life and cloud cover. The resort coast was located on Alakatha's northern continent.<ref name="I,J" />

The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] paid for [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] and [[Mirax Terrik Horn]] to honeymoon on Alakatha in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. [[11 ABY/Legends|Three years later]], [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] ambushed the ''[[Booty Full]]'', an [[Invids|Invid]] ship in the system to prevent a pirate [[Battle of Alakatha|raid]] on Alakatha.<ref name="I,J" />
